mechanism_narrative: The slight upturn in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT from t-1w to t-0w signals a gradual resumption of out-of-home routines that should spill into more retail trips over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays at or below its last-4-week mean for the next 28 days despite continued week-over-week gains in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays above +15 percent while PARKS remains near or below its recent average, more at-home time is converted into short neighborhood shopping trips, pushing RETAIL_REC upward within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains > 15 while PARKS does not rise above its t-0w level
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days in weeks where RESIDENTIAL stays above 15 and PARKS fails to strengthen.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls another few points from an already depressed level, access friction to shopping districts increases and retail-and-recreation mobility will weaken over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT drops below -62 after being above -62 in the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days after a TRANSIT drop through -62, or does not fall relative to the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized improvement in GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES indicates broader trip-making confidence and routine consolidation, which should lift RETAIL_REC within one week through shared trip chaining.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES both increase week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve in the following week when both GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES rise together.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in PARKS over four weeks usually diverts discretionary time toward outdoor activity, reducing retail-and-recreation visits over the same horizon.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to decline over the next 28 days despite a sustained upward trend in PARKS.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL eases from its elevated level while TRANSIT remains very low, people are less homebound but still face mobility friction, so retail mobility stays suppressed or weakens over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls week-on-week while TRANSIT stays below -60
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days in periods where RESIDENTIAL falls and TRANSIT remains below -60.

mechanism_narrative: A break above the recent plateau in WORKPLACES indicates reopening momentum that will expand weekday shopping traffic, lifting RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above -52 after spending at least two weeks below -52
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise within 14 days after WORKPLACES crosses above -52 from below.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM, TRANSIT, and WORKPLACES all improve together, the city is moving toward fuller mixed-purpose trip patterns that should raise retail-and-recreation mobility over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM, TRANSIT, and WORKPLACES all post week-on-week gains
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior 28-day mean over the next month after all three proxies rise together.
